messages:
incident-bot: P1 Pager — Serving fleet degraded for /v1/generate (INC-2026-042). Error rate spike detected in eu-west-1 and us-west-2. Paging infra oncall. Runbook: <https://runbook/redwood/inc/serving-rdma> :rotating_light:

sam.h: oncall sam.h here, reading alerts. I'm seeing a spike in container restarts + CUDA OOMs across a subset of rdma-enabled nodes. Starting quick triage.

sam.h: Observed symptoms:
- repeated CUDA OOM logs in runtime
- pods restarting with SIGKILL
- host kernel showing ibv errors (GDR timeouts)
- packet retransmit counters jumping on mlx5 interfaces

matt.t: ack. i'm pulling the node list now. which ASG/cluster?

sam.h: affected pool: serving-prod-eu1-gdr (10 nodes) and serving-prod-usw2-gdr (6 nodes). Not all GPUs — seems concentrated on nodes on the same ToR switch.

elaine: adding TL;DR for CS: some customers may see 5xx or latency spikes; routing/cooldown may help. @cust-success-bot can you surface to priority accounts?

cust-success-bot: Noted. I'll DM top 10 accounts and post a lightweight status note with ETA 30m.

sam.h: quick logs snippet:
```
[2026-03-15T12:02:09Z] runtime:error cuda: failed to allocate 1.2 GiB: out of memory
[2026-03-15T12:02:11Z] gdr: cq error - IB_TIMEOUT on qp 0x3f
[2026-03-15T12:02:12Z] kubelet: container restart backoff 1m
``` 
Link to aggregated logs: <https://logs.redwood/INC-2026-042>

rashid: running `ibstat` on node rdma-110 shows link flapping:
```
Port 1:	State: PortUp -> PortDown -> PortUp
Counter: LocalLinkIntegrityErrors increased rapidly
```
Could be a bad port / ToR flapping. Also seeing driver messages about gdr driver resetting qps.

matt.t: mitigation plan ideas:
1) immediate traffic steering: shift serving route to fallback variant small-llm-quant (eu1->eu1-fallback) to reduce memory.
2) cordon and drain most affected nodes, let autoscaler spin up more non-rdma nodes (fallback path)
3) reduce batch_size and token cache per-request as runtime config rollback
4) coordinate with infra to check ToR switch logs and clear ARP flaps

sam.h: doing 1) now — updating route config: `POST /admin/routes/serve` -> set policy to prefer fallback with 60% weight. Rolling.

infra-ops-bot: Route update queued. Expected propagation ~30s.

matt.t: I'm cordoning rdma-110 rdma-112 and evicting pods. Starting scaling of serving-non-rdma ASG by +4.

elaine: customer-impact check: error rate peaked at 6.8% in EU for 5xx, overall 2.1% across prod. Remember to annotate incident timeline for SLAs.

rashid: infra confirms ToR logs show intermittent CRC errors on port 3 for rack-42, hardware team notified. We'll run link flaps mitigation; if it persists, swap NICs or move workloads.

matt.t: taking incident lead. sam.h handing off after 20m. I'll update PSAT and runbooks. Pagers: suppress until we re-evaluate after 15m.

sam.h: handing off to matt.t — leaving a note: when swapping NICs, disable gdr on affected nodes temporarily (`modprobe -r gdrdrv`) to avoid qpair resets causing OOM cascade.

matt.t: acknowledged. I'll coordinate with hardware and CS, and post an update in 15.

incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-042 updated: owner=matt.t, status=mitigating, next_update=15m. :white_check_mark:
